resources.string: %1$s wants to use your microphone. Audio is handled by this daemon and its configured voice service.\n\nLeaving the app or opening another full-screen app will close this connection, even after recording stops. Unsent text may be lost.
This connection has microphone access. Reconnect first, then open or save the file again. Reconnecting stops microphone access and may discard unsent text. No file picker has been opened.
This connection was closed when the app left the foreground. Reconnect to continue; unsent page state may not have been saved.
Development client. Per-device credential revocation is not yet available.
Add a daemon connection to get started.
Remove %1$s and its saved credential from this device? This does not revoke the credential on the daemon.
Use HTTPS for remote daemons. A blank token without “Keep” uses no saved credential.
For a different address, enter its token or uncheck “Keep the saved credential”.
Could not save this connection. Retry before connecting.
Connections require WebView 111 or later with isolated profiles. New or recovered browser profiles also require complete browsing-data deletion support. Update the WebView provider and retry.
Wait for the WebView provider to finish clearing this connection’s previous browser data. No page or credential is loaded before completion. You can return to Connections and retry later.
Check the daemon address, connection and certificate, then retry.
Reconnect to open a new browser session.
The saved data could not be opened or migrated safely. Retry, or reset it and enter your connection details again.
Delete all saved connections and credentials on this device? You will need to enter them again. Daemon credentials are not revoked.
